text: When Elena moved to her new neighborhood last year, she was very happy. It is a friendly community, and most residents know each other. There is a small post office where she sends letters, and a pharmacy nearby for buying medicine. She also loves the public library because it's quiet and a perfect place to study. Near her house, there is a police station and a fire station, so the area feels very safe. For food, there is a big supermarket just a five-minute walk away, which is very convenient. Elena takes public transport to work every day; the bus stop is right outside her building. Sometimes the traffic in the city center is heavy, and the streets get crowded, but her own street stays calm. She always waits at the crossing and never crosses when the traffic light is red. Walking on the sidewalk in the evening, Elena feels comfortable because the streetlights are bright. Her neighborhood has many useful facilities, like a gym and a small park, so she rarely needs to travel far for anything.
